description: The link a person opens to buy tickets or register, with Spanish instructions to relay. For paid events (card or bank transfer), checkout opens with the ticket type and quantity already chosen. For free registration, it is the event page. Nothing is reserved or charged: the person completes it themselves.

quantity.description: For paid events: how many tickets, default 1.

ticket_type_id.description: For paid events: the ticket type id from get-event.

name: get-checkout-link
title: Get Checkout Link
